description: A witness is a finite proof, and a rule can occur again over the same span within it. The completed r → s, with the tags X, rests on s → r over the r → A [T] with the tags Y, which is eligible. A stage would not count that derivation, since r stands below r over one span, but the query does. So tags of r is X and Y (engine §4).
grammar:
%rule text A
%tags tags($, r)
%rule r A [+T] <Y> | s <X>
%rule s r
